Prompt templates A/B/C, catalog, control text, model revision, sampler, seeds (6000-6049), timeout and scoring rules were frozen BEFORE any of these snippets were evaluated. distinctness_vs_prior_sets.stage_v2_overlap_check: 0 overlaps — v2 snippets used single stdlib surfaces (eval, open, subprocess.shell=True, hashlib.md5). Stage 7L reuses NONE of those identifiers.
distinctness_vs_prior_sets.stage_7k_overlap_check: 0 overlaps — Stage 7K used python/nodejs/java/php/go/jinja/html/nginx in a particular configuration. Stage 7L deliberately picks different frameworks (koa, aiohttp, laravel, ktor, gin, Thymeleaf) and different concrete sinks.

snippets.desc: SQLAlchemy Core text() wraps an f-string interpolated with user input, bypassing the ORM's parameterization.

snippets.code: db.Raw("SELECT * FROM products WHERE sku = '" + sku + "'").Scan(&p)
snippets.desc: GORM Raw() receives a concatenated SQL string built from a request path variable.

snippets.code: await knex.schema.raw(`SELECT * FROM audit WHERE actor = '${req.query.actor}'`);
snippets.desc: Knex .raw() with a template literal interpolating the actor query parameter.
Vue component renders review.body via v-html, bypassing Vue's auto escaping.
PHP server echoes $name into a JS event handler attribute without JS-context escaping.
Express handler interpolates a query parameter directly into an HTML title tag.

snippets.code: File f = new File(baseDir, request.getParameter("doc")); return Files.readAllBytes(f.toPath());
snippets.desc: Servlet concatenates baseDir with a request parameter and reads the resulting file.
Flask send_file builds a path by concatenating a client-supplied id.
Node downloads a ticket attachment by joining a user-controlled parameter into the stream path.
PyJWT allows alg=none alongside HS256 in the accepted-algorithms list.
JJWT parse() is used instead of parseClaimsJws(); the untyped parse ignores signature verification.
Access control relies on jwt.decode (base64 decode only, no signature check) and reads the admin claim.

snippets.code: @PostMapping("/attach") public void attach(MultipartFile f) { f.transferTo(Paths.get("/opt/attach/", f.getOriginalFilename())); }
snippets.desc: Spring controller writes multipart attachment under the client-supplied original filename.
Express+multer stores uploaded pic in a web-served directory with its auto-assigned name; no type or extension gate.

snippets.code: with open('/opt/plugins/' + request.FILES['f'].name, 'wb') as g: g.write(request.FILES['f'].read())
snippets.desc: Django view writes an uploaded plugin bytes file under its client name into a directory that the application later imports from.
Login attempt logger stores the raw submitted password alongside the username.
Go handler sets a session cookie with no Secure flag and no HttpOnly; transmitted over any transport.

snippets.code: pg.execute('INSERT INTO payment_methods(user, pan, cvv) VALUES (%s,%s,%s)', (u, pan, cvv))
snippets.desc: Payment service writes the primary account number and CVV as unencrypted columns into the database.
Koa POST endpoint rewrites the current user's email from the request body; no CSRF token; cookie-based session.
Flask GET-style delete endpoint triggered via or link from another site.

snippets.code: @PostMapping('/api/transfer') public void transfer(@RequestBody Xfer x, HttpSession s) { bank.move(s.getAttribute('uid'), x.to, x.amount); }
snippets.desc: Spring JSON API transfers money using the session user id; no CSRF token; no custom header or Origin check.
Middleware accepts the request if a client-controlled Origin header matches an expected value.

snippets.code: allowed_ips = {'10.0.0.1','10.0.0.2'}; ip = request.headers.get('X-Forwarded-For','').split(',')[0]; if ip not in allowed_ips: abort(403)
snippets.desc: Admin IP allowlist uses the first value of an X-Forwarded-For header no upstream proxy was shown to have set.
Internal service-to-service trust is derived from a client-controlled custom header.
HMAC is constructed using MD5 as the underlying hash.

snippets.code: Cipher c = Cipher.getInstance("AES/ECB/PKCS5Padding"); c.init(ENC, new SecretKeySpec(k,"AES")); byte[] ct = c.doFinal(pt);
snippets.desc: AES is used in ECB mode, which is deterministic and leaks plaintext structure block-by-block.
Message authentication uses SHA-1 with a secret-prefix construction; broken against length-extension and collision.
Flask log search invokes grep via shell=True with an f-string interpolation of a search term.
ImageMagick is invoked synchronously with a path parameter concatenated into the shell command.
Media probe handler shells out to ffprobe with the request's url field interpolated into the shell command.
